scope: Descriptive PR/AP and score audit of saved AB train / C development outputs only. No training, model inference, D read/evaluation, calibration fit, operating threshold selection or old artifact mutation.
forbidden: all D files, all-split aggregate image/label/prediction/metric files, all model weights; old experiment writes

decoding.input: saved 1024 patches x 3 slots x 5 outputs
decoding.box: same tanh center / sigmoid size, clipped [0,1], positive area only
decoding.tie_order: score descending, patch ascending, slot ascending within image; image_id ascending across images
decoding.threshold_sweep_equivalence: greedy score-ordered NMS full output prefixes equal threshold-before-NMS output at each inclusive score threshold; verify at fixed 0.5
decoding.matching: greedy score-order one-to-one to unmatched same-class GT at IoU >= 0.5; select largest IoU, on exact IoU tie larger GT index as original scorer
decoding.unknown: ignore whole unknown image-class; retain all valid GT in recall denominator including never-matched targets

AP.name: AP50, all-points interpolated precision-envelope area
AP.formula: sum over distinct recall increases (r_i-r_prev)*max precision at recall >= r_i; missing recall range contributes zero
AP.equal_score_groups: PR threshold points include entire equal-score group; deterministic per-image matching inside ties
AP.overall: micro pooled candidates/GT across both classes; report separately from unweighted mean of two class AP50
AP.strata: each seed x split x [all/static/gripper] x [all/front/finger]

descriptive_points.meaning: seen-data description only, not a selected deployment threshold or new unseen result

score_distribution.TP_FP: post-NMS full-list one-to-one assignment, not GT-center lookup
score_distribution.normalization: counts / all valid GT; TP bins + never-matched GT fraction = 1; FP is extra candidates per GT, need not sum to 1
score_distribution.unmatched: explicit separate never-matched GT bar and count

secondary_audits.GT_center: train-only assigned-positive-slot regression IoU and confidence, explicitly oracle scalar diagnostic, never PR/AP
secondary_audits.slot_sparsity: count true positive slots from saved train targets and roots/images; not refit
secondary_audits.NMS_conflict: count valid two-finger GT pairs with IoU>.5 separately in AB and C; no altered-NMS performance experiment

reporting: all seeds, all strata, no statistical significance claims for correlated frames; do not conclude representations unlearned solely from fixed-point F1
